final: WITH w AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats),''),'') AS hand FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id), c AS (SELECT hand, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM w GROUP BY hand), s AS (SELECT hand, player_count, CAST(player_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(player_count) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.hand AS bats, s.player_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_above_average FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
